rows.grounds: present passive participle expressing the action of being cut
optative verb expressing potential or hypothetical cutting
compound describing one who has reached that state
possessive compound describing one whose mind is directed to that

items.question: Can a person absorbed in that state be harmed when physically cut?
premises: A person may be subjected to the act of being cut.
A person can have the mind fixed on and gone to that state.
Absorption in that state alters the experience of physical harm.
items.inference: Therefore, one whose mind is absorbed in that state is not truly cut even while being cut.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'that' (tad) depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Just as one who has gone to that state and whose mind is fixed on it, even while being cut, is not cut.
